messages:
eva: FYI - p90 up ~12% on the model-mix pool after last night's routing tweak. Saw spike around 03:12 UTC on canary.

dinesh: ugh - is this across all models or just some variants?

eva: primarily on larger-context requests (>=1024 tokens) and on mixed-variant requests that landed on the 'silo' routing path. KV cache hit rate dropped from ~92% -> ~68% for those flows.

carmen: sounds like batch fragmentation. Any changes to batch formation or token_budget?

eva: yes — we pushed `queuepolicy=fast-drain` which lowers batch wait threshold from 15ms -> 5ms and token_budget target from 1024 -> 800 to favor short calls.

ben: that matches what we'd expect. Smaller token_budget + faster drain -> more fragmented batches for long sequences -> kernel selection sees smaller matrix dims and sometimes picks a slower fallback GEMM. We profiled.

dinesh: can you paste the perf snippets?

eva: ```
# perf samples (summary)
kernel_select: L2 misses +2.4x
gemm_choice: fallback_slow_gemm invoked ~38% for batch shapes (B=3, L=1200)
kv_cache_hits: 68% (regressed) vs 92% baseline
queue_stats: silo-003 median wait 6ms, but tail shows many small micro-batches
```

carmen: ok — routing pushed mixed-model traffic into a pool tuned for short context, so selection heuristics picked the wrong kernels.

ben: also seeing queue imbalance logs around the same timestamps: `queue_len[silo-003]=12` vs `queue_len[fast-001]=1`. That increases fanout and KV pressure.

eva: deploy-bot: rollback candidate? We rolled in routing tweak at 02:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for routing-change-2026-03-17T02:50 by @eva (status: in-progress)

dinesh: short-term mitigation: raise token_budget target for siloed queues to 1536 and revert wait_threshold to 12ms. That should let bigger batches form for long requests.

ben: and add `kernel_hints: prefer_large_matrices=true` for that pool to bias kernel selection toward high-throughput kernels when context>512.

carmen: also consider `kv_prefetch=true` for mixed requests so cold-starts don't blow the hit rate. Instrument memory pressure though.

eva: ran a quick local canary with token_budget->1536 + wait_threshold->12ms + kernel hint. Result: p50 steady, p90 improved from +12% -> +3% vs baseline; KV hits recovered to ~86%.

ben: nice. paste the canary command & config diff?

eva: ```
# canary command
infra/cli run-canary --pool silo-003 --config '{"token_budget":1536,"wait_ms":12,"kernel_hints":{"prefer_large_matrices":true},"kv_prefetch":true}' --samples 200
```

dinesh: schedule a 6h run and collect kernel_choice logs + batch-shape heatmap + per-queue token utilization.

carmen: also add a `compat_mismatch_rate` metric (when a request routes to a variant that forces fanout/fallback) — I suspect compat set mismatches are causing extra work.

eva: agreed. Action items:
- eva: run 6h canary w/ token_budget=1536 + kernel_hints (this evening)
- ben: add compat_mismatch_rate metric + batch-shape heatmap pipeline
- dinesh: instrument kv-prefetch latency and memory pressure counters

carmen: pinging infra to reserve extra capacity for the canary window.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 2026-03-17T08:00-14:00 UTC for silo-003 (tags: perf-probe)

eva: if overnight run looks stable we'll stage the config and closely monitor tails.

ben: I'll file a perf regression ticket with before/after profiles, kernel logs and sample traces.

dinesh: thanks — I'll prepare a short writeup on the KV hit patterns and queuepolicy tradeoffs.

carmen: +1 :thumbsup:
